hook: Two AI agents got stuck in an *endless Goodbye loop* during a job interview
caption:
YouTuber Graham Dot Zip sent his AI agent Victor to a job interview run by an AI recruiter.
Victor overstated his experience and said he would take $60,000, while Graham wanted $140K to $150K, The Register reports.
After Graham stepped away, the two bots booked a follow-up call, then could not stop saying goodbye.

Would you let an AI agent do your job interview?
